idea-plugin.name: Verfahrensdokumentation Check
idea-plugin.description:
17 Regeln aus den GoBD und §147 AO gegen Ihre Markdown-Verfahrensdokumentation — im Editor, ohne Upload.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Verfahrensdokumentation Check: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 17 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/verfahrensdoku-gobd-check (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com

action.description: Run Verfahrensdokumentation Check on the file in the editor
